expectation: I expect the directed builders to join the amino acids into collagen, though it may still need processing.

effect: Surface coverage is restored, while deeper tissue continues rebuilding and may retain a scar. The result connects repair to the earlier muscle-cell work.
reaction: The return to the same body that held the glass gives the repair a satisfying context.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making and placing the supporting fibers was most worthwhile because it connected protein production inside cells to rebuilding tissue outside them.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final surface-repair sequence felt predictable because each step offered only one combination.

surprise.text: I found it interesting that cells make collagen material inside themselves and export it to form support outside the cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the offered combinations had clear purposes in making support or restoring coverage.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored a different body process. The connections between cellular work and tissue repair held my interest, though the choices were often predictable.
